env GO111MODULE=on

# Populate go.sum
go list -m -mod=mod all

# Check for upgrades for all modules (should include direct and indirect).
go list -m -u all
stdout 'rsc.io/quote v1.2.0 \[v1\.5\.2\]'
stdout 'golang.org/x/text v0.3.0'

# Check for upgrades for direct dependencies only.
go list -m -u direct
stdout '^rsc.io/quote v1.2.0 \[v1\.5\.2\]$'
! stdout 'golang.org/x/text'

-- go.mod --
module x
require (
    rsc.io/quote v1.2.0
    golang.org/x/text v0.3.0 // indirect
)
